headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 31, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Garrett Cleavinger earning the win and Bryan Baker securing the save. The Kansas City Royals fell short in Minnesota, losing 3-4 to the Twins, while the New York Yankees dropped a 1-2 decision to the Chicago White Sox. The Chicago Cubs took down the St. Louis Cardinals 4-2, with Jacob Webb earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Jakob Junis, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Texas Rangers due to a left adductor strain. The move is retroactive to July 29, 2026. Other injured players include Jose Corniell, Danny Jansen, Curtis Mead, Byron Buxton, Cole Sulser, Vinnie Pasquantino, and Casey Schmitt.

The Detroit Tigers made a move on July 30, 2026, acquiring right-handed pitcher Zane Barnhart from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for catcher Jake Rogers. The Los Angeles Angels traded catcher Logan O'Hoppe and right-handed pitcher Chase Silseth to the Texas Rangers for shortstop Angel Arredondo. The Baltimore Orioles traded right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash, and the San Diego Padres signed shortstop Nu'u Contrades.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals lost to the Minnesota Twins 3-4 in a close game. Kody Clemens led the Royals' offense with a grand slam in the game.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dropped a 1-2 decision to the Chicago White Sox, unable to overcome the hosts' strong performance. Trent Grisham led the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Cardinals 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 4-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Jacob Webb earning the win. JJ Wetherholt led the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.summary: Jakob Junis, a right-handed pitcher for the Texas Rangers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left adductor strain. The move is retroactive to July 29, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire RHP Zane Barnhart in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on July 30, 2026, acquiring right-handed pitcher Zane Barnhart from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for catcher Jake Rogers.
